grain_rationale: dataset.row_count is 166158 and dataset.duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, so no exact duplicate rows exist at the source; each row already represents one scheduled flight leg. No single column is unique on its own (flight_number has distinct_count 2994 against row_count 166158), so grain_type is transaction with a derived identity flight_identity over flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport, and dest_airport; the zero duplicate_row_rate means this tuple is expected to be unique without any aggregation.

fields.name: flight_date
fields.description: Calendar date of the scheduled flight, null_rate 0.0, ranging 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30 across 181 distinct days per the profile.

fields.name: carrier_code
fields.description: Two-letter operating carrier code, null_rate 0.0, with 16 distinct values such as 9E, AA, DL in the profile.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: Operating carrier's flight number ranging 1 to 8500 with 2994 distinct values and null_rate 0.0; it labels a specific flight rather than measuring a quantity.

fields.name: origin_airport
fields.description: Origin airport code, null_rate 0.0, with exactly 3 distinct values (EWR, JFK, LGA) per the profile.

fields.name: sched_dep_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled departure time in local HHMM encoding, null_rate 0.0, ranging 500 to 2359 across 969 distinct values; it encodes a time label, not an additive quantity.

fields.name: dest_airport
fields.description: Destination airport code, null_rate 0.0, with 100 distinct values per the profile such as ABQ, ACK, ALB.

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: Aircraft tail registration, null_rate 0.009154 (1521 nulls), nullable when the operating aircraft's tail could not be matched to the flight record.

fields.name: is_cancelled
fields.description: Flag with distinct_values [false, true] and null_rate 0.0 indicating whether the flight was cancelled.

fields.name: dep_hhmm
fields.description: Actual departure time in local HHMM encoding, null_rate 0.029388 (4883 nulls), nullable for flights that never departed, consistent with the cancellation flag.

fields.name: dep_delay_minutes
fields.description: Departure delay in minutes, ranging -33 to 1301, null_rate 0.029388 matching dep_hhmm's null pattern; an additive quantity summed or averaged across flights.

fields.name: arr_hhmm
fields.description: Actual arrival time in local HHMM encoding, null_rate 0.0307 (5101 nulls), nullable for flights lacking a recorded arrival.

fields.name: sched_arr_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled arrival time in local HHMM encoding, null_rate 0.0, ranging 1 to 2359 across 1134 distinct values.

fields.name: arr_delay_minutes
fields.description: Arrival delay in minutes, ranging -86 to 1272, null_rate 0.032981; an additive quantity suitable for summation or averaging across flights.

fields.name: air_time_minutes
fields.description: Airborne flight duration in minutes, ranging 20 to 695, null_rate 0.032981 matching arr_delay_minutes' null pattern for flights without a recorded arrival.

fields.name: distance_miles
fields.description: Great-circle distance flown in miles, ranging 80 to 4983, null_rate 0.0; an additive quantity across flights.

fields.name: sched_dep_hour_local
fields.description: Local scheduled departure hour, null_rate 0.0, with 19 distinct values from 5 to 23 per the profile's distinct_values list.

fields.name: sched_dep_minute_local
fields.description: Local scheduled departure minute, null_rate 0.0, with 60 distinct values from 0 to 59.

fields.name: departure_hour_utc
fields.description: UTC departure timestamp, null_rate 0.0, with 3439 distinct values spanning 2013-01-01T10:00:00 to 2013-07-01T03:00:00; samples resolve only to the hour (minute and second always :00:00), establishing the event's time axis.

fields.name: carrier_name

fields.name: aircraft_manufacturer
fields.description: Aircraft manufacturer, null_rate 0.160426 (26656 nulls), nullable when the tail number could not be matched to an aircraft registry record, matching tail_number's partial coverage.

fields.name: aircraft_model
fields.description: Aircraft model designation, null_rate 0.160426, sharing the same null pattern as aircraft_manufacturer for unmatched registrations.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacture_year

fields.name: aircraft_seat_count

fields.name: aircraft_engine_type
fields.description: Aircraft engine type, null_rate 0.160426, with 6 distinct values such as Turbo-fan and Turbo-jet.

fields.name: origin_elevation_ft
fields.description: Elevation of the origin airport in feet, null_rate 0.0, with 3 distinct values (13, 18, 21); an airport attribute rather than a flight measure.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Ingestion capture timestamp, null_rate 0.0, with only 16 distinct values clustered within a few seconds on 2026-09-02; it records when the row was captured, not the flight's business time, so it is not used as time_column.

category_description: One row represents a single scheduled flight leg operated by a carrier from one origin airport to one destination airport on a given flight_date, carrying its scheduling, actual timing, delay, distance, and matched aircraft and airport attributes as profiled in silver.silver_flights.
purpose: This mapping declares how the contracted silver.silver_flights table enters the gold unified event star as the flights fact category, specifying its time column, grain, identifiers, and field roles for the deterministic modeling engine that renders the gold fact and its dimensions; it proposes no quality rules, ownership, or physical objects.
usage: The deterministic renderer turns this proposal into an ODCS gold mapping contract draft scoped to flights, which the frozen mapping-contract schema, a validator, and datacontract lint gate before a human reviewer edits and approves it; only after approval does the modeling engine consume the contract to emit gold models.
limitations: The mapping does not exclude cancelled flights (is_cancelled true) or rows with null dep_hhmm/arr_hhmm/arr_delay_minutes/air_time_minutes (null_rate 0.029388-0.032981) from the fact; it leaves any filtering or imputation to downstream consumers. It also does not resolve the 16.04%-17.65% null rates on aircraft_manufacturer, aircraft_model, aircraft_manufacture_year, aircraft_seat_count, and aircraft_engine_type, nor the 2.089% nulls on destination airport reference attributes, leaving those gaps for consumers to handle. The captured_at column's apparent future dates (2026-09-02) are reported as profiled without further explanation.
